description: §19.16.2 — on a `return` exit the return value is evaluated FIRST, then the deferred bodies run; a deferred body cannot change the value already returned. take() returns @count (7) and its deferred body then sets @count = 99: @got = 7, @count = 99, the other deferred body ran too (trace = "d").
rationale: §19.16.2 Exit: `return` (after the return value has been evaluated — the deferred body cannot change it). The returned value is the pre-defer @count; the deferred write is still observable afterwards.
